title: Settings
description: A small set of controls. The rest of Sifty stays out of your way.

account.title: Account
account.descriptionBypass: Running with SIFTY_DISABLE_AUTH=1 — sign-in is bypassed for local development.
account.description: Capture, organize, and sync are free for everyone. Sifting with AI is where plans differ.
account.siftsUnlimited: {count, plural, one {# sift} other {# sifts}} today — unlimited
account.siftsFairUse: {count, plural, one {# sift} other {# sifts}} today — unlimited, fair-use cap {cap}/day

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Every device signed in to this account. Signing out elsewhere takes effect immediately.
sessions.signOutOthers: {count, plural, one {Sign out # other device} other {Sign out # other devices}}

language.title: Language
language.description: The language Sifty uses on this browser.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Sifty looks best in the dark, but it's your call.

model.title: AI model
model.description: Pick the trade-off between speed and depth. Each choice sets a primary model and a fallback from another provider, so an outage never stalls your list. Edits you make are protected from being overwritten.

behavior.title: AI behavior
behavior.description: Provider keys and the transport (AI Gateway or direct) are set in the server environment. Sifty never asks for a key in the browser.

data.title: Data
data.description: Tasks, labels, and memories sync to your account. This browser also keeps a local cache for instant loads — resetting it does not delete synced data.
data.resetConfirm: Reset this browser's local Sifty cache? Synced data is unaffected.
data.exportNote: The export is a JSON file with your tasks, labels, memories, and AI runs.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.description: Permanently deletes your account, every task, label, memory, and AI run, and cancels any subscription. There is no undo — export first if you want a copy.
deleteAccount.dialogBody: This removes everything in Sifty for <hl>{email}</hl> and cancels any subscription. It cannot be undone.
